list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Rebrand plugin from WOWRestro to WooRestro.
- Updated plugin name, description, and documentation references in `wowrestro.php` and `readme.txt`. - Replaced WOWRestro references with WooRestro across admin menus, product metaboxes, and setting screens. - Updated user-facing notices, settings descriptions, and plugin action links. - Refreshed translation source strings in `languages/wowrestro.pot`. - Cleaned up device streaming configurations in IDE project settings (`.idea/misc.xml`).

task.summary:
Initial implementation of the WOWRestro ordering system plugin for WooCommerce.
- Established core plugin architecture including main `WowRestro` class and dependency checks for WooCommerce. - Implemented comprehensive admin settings interface with tabs for general options, pickup/delivery services, styling, and notifications. - Added AJAX-based frontend ordering system featuring product modals, live cart updates, and category sidebar navigation. - Integrated pickup and delivery service logic with support for store hours, time intervals, and "ASAP" ordering. - Implemented support for product modifiers (add-ons) and enhanced product variation selection via radio buttons. - Added metadata markers for vegetarian and non-vegetarian items. - Included asset library for responsive design, custom iconography, and administrative styling. - Provided a templating system for customizable frontend layouts including cart contents, totals, and product summaries. - Added license management and automated update support for extensions.
